specification: Eduqas C700QS, current local specification v3 January 2019; preparation for 2027
coverage: Component 2 Section A: AO1 explicit and implicit meanings, selection and synthesis
AO2 language, structure, tone, effects and relevant vocabulary
AO3 ideas, perspectives and how they are conveyed across two texts
Authentic 1832 public-domain selections paired with original modern opinion writing
assessment: The official sample uses short retrieval tasks, 4-mark synthesis and 10-mark analysis, evaluation and comparison. The shared practice pair is shorter than a full exam pair (normally about 900–1200 words); it is a skills practice set, not a complete mock. Text A contains public-domain passages attributed to Lydia M. Child (1832), selected in original order from the official sample. Text B is newly authored modern practice. Questions and answers are original; no recurrence claim is made.
